story.text: 이틀 뒤, 나는 지하철을 타려고 안국역 계단을 내려가고 있었다. 서울에서 지낸 지 며칠 안 됐지만, 이 도시에 조금씩 익숙해지는 중이었다.
story.reading: i-teul dwi, na-neun ji-ha-cheol-eul ta-ryeo-go an-guk-yeok gye-dan-eul nae-ryeo-ga-go iss-eot-da. seo-ul-e-seo ji-naen ji myeot-il an dwaet-ji-man, i do-si-e jo-geum-ssik ik-suk-hae-ji-neun jung-i-eot-da.
story.en: Two days later, I was heading down the stairs at Anguk Station to catch the subway. I hadn't been in Seoul long, but I was slowly getting used to the city.

story.text: 그런데 지하철역 개찰구 앞에서, 낯익은 얼굴이 서 있었다. 규현이었다. 이번엔 제복이 아니라 편한 셔츠 차림이었다.
story.reading: geu-reon-de ji-ha-cheol-yeok gae-chal-gu ap-e-seo, nach-ik-eun eol-gul-i seo iss-eot-da. gyu-hyeon-i-eot-da. i-beon-en je-bok-i a-ni-ra pyeon-han shyeo-cheu cha-rim-i-eot-da.
story.en: But standing in front of the subway station's turnstiles was a familiar face. It was Kyuhyun. This time he wasn't in uniform — he was dressed casually in a shirt.

story.text: 그는 놀란 척 눈을 크게 떴다. '어, 또 마주치네요? 이거 참 신기하네.'
story.reading: geu-neun nol-lan cheok nun-eul keu-ge tteot-da. eo, tto ma-ju-chi-ne-yo? i-geo cham sin-gi-ha-ne.
story.en: He widened his eyes in mock surprise. "Oh, we run into each other again? That's pretty strange."

story.text: 서울처럼 큰 도시에서 이틀 만에 같은 사람을 또 만나다니. 우연치고는 너무 절묘하다는 생각이 스쳤지만, 그는 태연하게 웃고만 있었다.
story.reading: seo-ul-cheo-reom keun do-si-e-seo i-teul man-e gat-eun sa-ram-eul tto man-na-da-ni. u-yeon-chi-go-neun neo-mu jeol-myo-ha-da-neun saeng-gak-i seu-chyeot-ji-man, geu-neun tae-yeon-ha-ge ut-go-man iss-eot-da.
story.en: Running into the same person again after just two days, in a city as big as Seoul — it crossed my mind that this seemed like too perfect a coincidence, but he just kept smiling calmly.

story.text: '뭐, 그래도 반가운 우연이잖아요. 안 그래요?' 그는 어깨를 으쓱하며 자연스럽게 내 옆에서 걸음을 맞췄다.
story.reading: mwo, geu-rae-do ban-ga-un u-yeon-i-jan-a-yo. an geu-rae-yo? geu-neun eo-kkae-reul eu-sseuk-ha-myeo ja-yeon-seu-rop-ge nae yeop-e-seo geol-eum-eul mat-chwot-da.
story.en: "Well, it's still a happy coincidence, isn't it?" He shrugged and fell into step naturally beside me.

story.text: '그래서, 오늘은 어디 가는 길이에요? 시간 괜찮으면 잠깐 대화나 좀 하고 갈래요?'
story.reading: geu-rae-seo, o-neul-eun eo-di ga-neun gil-i-e-yo? si-gan gwaen-chan-eu-myeon jam-kkan dae-hwa-na jom ha-go gal-lae-yo?
story.en: "So, where are you headed today? If you've got time, want to stick around for a bit of conversation?"

story.text: 딱히 거절할 이유가 없었다. 아니, 사실은… 나도 조금 더 이야기하고 싶었던 것 같다.
story.reading: ttak-hi geo-jeol-hal i-yu-ga eop-seot-da. a-ni, sa-sil-eun… na-do jo-geum deo i-ya-gi-ha-go sip-eot-deon geot gat-da.
story.en: I couldn't think of a real reason to say no. Or rather... I think, honestly, I wanted to talk with him a little longer too.

words.example_en: Was meeting him really just a coincidence?
I bumped into him by chance on the street.
We agreed to meet in front of the subway station.

words.meaning: to be glad, pleased (to see someone)
words.example_en: I was really glad to see him again.

sentences.en: Was meeting him really just a coincidence?
I bumped into him by chance on the street.
We agreed to meet in front of the subway station.
I was really glad to see him again.
